Subject: Evening anchor slot offer + opt-in for multi-prospect roundtable

Hi Tom, Asha —

Thanks for the interest in a short multi-prospect roundtable where we can show a focused walkthrough of latency/cost tradeoffs for inference at scale and answer integration questions. To keep this compact and make it workable for folks across regions, were proposing an "anchor" evening slot and a simple opt-in process so participants self-select the session that works for them.

Two anchor slot options (pick one on reply):
- Option A: Tue, July 10 — 6:00 PM PT / Wed, July 11 — 9:00 AM SGT
- Option B: Wed, July 11 — 8:00 PM PT / Thu, July 12 — 11:00 AM SGT

Plan (30-45 minutes):
- 10 min: 3-4 minute lightning intros from each company
- 20 min: 15-minute demo + 5-minute deep-dive on routing/caching
- 10-15 min: Q&A and next-step pairing (follow-ups/tech dive scheduling)

Attachments: agenda draft (PDF) and a calendar invite stub (ICS) included below — these are draft, well finalize after folks opt in.

Quick asks:
1) Reply with your preferred anchor (A or B) and whether youd like recording shared.
2) If you need a separate APAC-friendly session or prefer a 1:1 follow-up instead of the group, note that as well.

Soojin and Vanessa: can you help moderate and own the technical Q&A? Ill handle intros and keep time.

Best,
Ben

Thanks Ben — quick note from the ops side.

I can moderate the APAC overlap and will take the technical Q&A segment. A couple of operational points:
- APAC teams often prefer an earlier SGT slot; if we go with Option A (6PM PT / 9AM SGT) that lines up well for EMEA & APAC mornings. Option B is later for APAC and might reduce participation.
- Suggest we offer a short recording + a two-question pre-demo intake form (1: whats your primary technical constraint? 2: which infra/hardware do you use?) so we can tailor the 15-minute deep-dive.
- Suggest we cap live participants at 6 external companies to keep Q&A productive; we can run a second run if opt-ins exceed capacity.

Ill add the intake form to the shared doc once Ben posts the draft agenda.
